title: 第九章 准备第十章 五行归元桩入门
slug: 武道每日加点打更人肝成人间武圣
content_zh:
这话一出，房间内瞬间安静了下来。
老许瞬间就跳了起来，之前他就看不惯秦苏他爹把差事顺给秦苏，现在让他逮住机会了。
“秦老大真是有一个好儿子，才走了几天，他儿子就要把他求爷爷告奶奶的铁饭碗给辞了，说出去还不让人笑话。”
老周也放下茶碗，脸色沉了下来，语气不悦：“秦苏，你可要想清楚了？外城有多少人盯着这份差事，好歹是吃官家饭的，稳当。”
“你辞了，往后在想回来，可就没门了。”
“我想清楚了。”秦苏看了一眼老许，然后看向老周，坚定地说道：“我找了别的活计，这打更得活，顾不过来了。”
秦苏也没提练武的事情，免得节外生枝。
旁人眼中的铁饭碗，现在在秦苏这里，已经成了困住他成长的牢笼了。
“小苏，你别冲动！”王叔连忙拉住他的胳膊，急切地说道：“你爹走之前，特意托我照看你，这差事是他留给你唯一的后路啊！你年纪轻轻，别一时糊涂，把后路断了！”
“王叔，我没糊涂。”秦苏摇了摇头，“我意已决，您就不用再劝了，而且我真的找到了其他的活计。”
当下，练武就是秦苏最大的出路，秦守业一家，青石帮哪个不是看他好欺负，没本事就能踩上一脚。
老周见秦苏态度坚决，冷哼一声，扔过来一张纸。
“行，想辞就辞吧，画押吧。”
“把梆子、腰牌都交上来，往后这打更的差事，就和你没关系了。”
秦苏接过纸笔，在纸上签字，然后把腰牌和梆子归还，对着老周拱了拱手，转身往外走，身后还传来老许的嘲讽声。
他走出院子，径直往归一武馆走去。
现在回去，正好能赶上晚饭，还能再练一会儿。
晚饭依旧是米饭管够，一碗肥瘦相间的猪肉，一碗骨头汤。
夕阳落尽，武馆里的弟子走了大半，只剩零星几个还在苦练。
秦苏一遍遍的打磨五行归元桩的细节，直到闭馆的钟声响起，他才收起架势，准备回家。

实际上，武馆有专门的住宿，但是每个月二百文，林家只包了入门的束脩，其余开销一概不管，那秦苏自然不会动用练功的银子，花在这方面。
夜里关上门，秦苏凝神看向面板，当日努力程度结算，得到一点天赋点，他把这一点增加到根骨上。
似乎有一点提升，但是几乎感受不到，秦苏明白，这必须较长的时间才能看到一点起色。
明天的增加在悟性上，两个轮换着来，这样的话，就比较均衡。
根骨的提升会让秦苏的气血承载、体质等全方位的提升，而悟性的增加，则会大大提升他对功法的领悟。
至于为什么不直接增加到五行归元桩上面，是因为性价比太低。
等他把根骨和悟性提升上来，功法的提升自然也会很快，但提升功法，却不会让自己的根骨和悟性增加，这是一个长远的打算。
接下来的几天，秦苏每天天黑出门，天黑回家，除了必要的吃饭喝水，练功几乎就没停。
他在演武场练功的地方，都变得光滑了些许。
第九天中午吃饭的时候，秦苏看向面板。
【姓名：秦苏】
【境界：凡人】
【根骨：25】
【悟性：14】
【功法：五行归元桩：910（未入门）】
【天赋点：10】
秦苏的五行归元桩，只差临门一脚就能入门。
午后，演武场刚热闹起来，另一边突然传来一声大叫。
众人循声望去，只见张小乙扎着马步，看样子原本瘦弱的身板竟然稳如磐石，脚下的青石板被踩出浅浅的痕迹。
正是五行归元桩入门的标志，力从得起，筋骨通顺。

“我入门了！我的五行归元桩，入门了！”张小乙脸上满是狂喜，声音带着兴奋。
content_en:
As soon as these words came out, the room instantly became quiet.
Lao Xu jumped up in an instant. Before, he couldn't stand Qin Su's father giving his job to Qin Su, but now he was allowed to seize the opportunity.
"Boss Qin really has a good son. He has only been gone for a few days, and his son is about to give up his iron job, which he begged his grandpa to sue his grandma. If he tells it, he won't make people laugh."
Lao Zhou also put down his tea bowl, his face darkened, and he said in a displeased tone: "Qin Su, have you thought about it clearly? How many people in the outer city are eyeing this job? After all, it's official food, so it's safe."
"If you resign, you may want to come back later, but there is no way."
"I have thought it through." Qin Su glanced at Lao Xu, then looked at Lao Zhou, and said firmly: "I have found other jobs, and this one is a better job, so I can't take care of it anymore."
Qin Su didn't mention martial arts training either, so as not to cause any complications.
The iron rice bowl in the eyes of others has now become a prison for Qin Su, trapping his growth.
"Xiao Su, don't be impulsive!" Uncle Wang quickly took his arm and said eagerly: "Before your father left, he specifically asked me to take care of you. This job is the only escape route he left for you! You are young, don't be confused and cut off your escape route!"
"Uncle Wang, I'm not confused." Qin Su shook his head, "I've made up my mind, you don't need to persuade me anymore, and I really found other jobs."
At the moment, practicing martial arts is Qin Su's biggest way out. Qin Shouye's family and the Qingshi Gang don't think he is easy to bully, and they can step on him if he has no ability.
Seeing Qin Su's resolute attitude, Lao Zhou snorted coldly and threw a piece of paper over.
"Okay, if you want to resign, just resign. Just sign."
"Hand over your bangzi and waist badges. From now on, the job of doing the watch will have nothing to do with you."
Qin Su took the pen and paper, signed on the paper, then returned the waist badge and clapper, bowed his hands to Lao Zhou, turned around and walked out, with Lao Xu's mocking voice coming from behind.
He walked out of the yard and walked straight to Guiyi Martial Arts Hall.
Go back now, just in time for dinner and practice some more.
Dinner is still enough rice, a bowl of fat and thin pork, and a bowl of bone soup.
As the sun sets, most of the disciples in the martial arts hall have left, leaving only a few who are still training hard.
Qin Su polished the details of the Five Elements Guiyuan Stake over and over again. It wasn't until the closing bell rang that he put away his posture and prepared to go home.
In fact, the martial arts school has special accommodation, but for two hundred yuan a month, the Lin family only covers the entry-level training, and does not care about other expenses. Naturally, Qin Su will not use the training money to spend it on this.
After closing the door at night, Qin Su looked at the panel attentively. After calculating his efforts for the day, he got some talent points, which he added to his bones.
There seemed to be a slight improvement, but he could barely feel it. Qin Su understood that it would take a longer time to see any improvement.
Tomorrow's increase in understanding will be done alternately. In this case, it will be more balanced.
The improvement of his root bones will improve Qin Su's energy and blood carrying capacity and physical fitness in all aspects, while the increase of his understanding will greatly enhance his understanding of the techniques.
As for why it is not added directly to the Five Elements Guiyuan Pile, it is because the price/performance ratio is too low.
When he improves his foundation and understanding, his skills will naturally improve quickly, but improving his skills will not increase his foundation and understanding. This is a long-term plan.
In the next few days, Qin Su would go out at dusk every day and come home at dusk. Except for necessary meals and drinks, he would practice almost non-stop.
The areas where he practiced martial arts became a little smoother.
During lunch on the ninth day, Qin Su looked at the panel.
[Name: Qin Su]
[Realm: Mortal]
【Root bone: 25】
【Comprehension: 14】
[Exercise: Five Elements Returning to the Origin Stake: 910 (not yet started)]
[Talent points: 10]
Qin Su's Five Elements Guiyuan Stake is just one step away from getting started.
In the afternoon, the martial arts arena just became lively, there was a sudden shout from the other side.
Everyone followed the sound and saw Zhang Xiaoyi striding forward. It seemed that his originally thin body was as stable as a rock, and shallow marks were left on the bluestone beneath his feet.
It is the symbol of the Five Elements Guiyuan Zhuang, which means that you can maintain your strength and keep your muscles and bones smooth.
"I'm ready! My Five Elements Guiyuan Stake is ready!" Zhang Xiaoyi's face was filled with ecstasy and his voice was filled with excitement.
